description.en: Dollocaris-inspired deep enclosing bivalved carapace, two enlarged anterior eyes seated into cephalic bases and exactly three paired grasping cephalic limbs, with a restrained short posterior appendage fringe. Static teaching form, no predation demonstration or microscopic compound-eye claim.
description.zh: Dollocaris启发深罩双瓣甲，两枚大前眼嵌入头部眼基，三对捕捉头足自然接入整体头部，壳后腹缘短肢省简。静态教学造型，无捕食演示或微观复眼复原。
